'''0.29c''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that adjusted some weapon stats and fixed various bugs.

==Changelog==
===Renaissance Army===
* MNP-3 moved to the 5th level of reputation
* RGO moved to the 6th level of reputation

===Fringe Settlers===
* You can now carry only one MON-50 mine which was moved to the 6th level of reputation

===Black Market===
* [[FN P90]] damage reduced to 26, dispersion increased to 0.3, range reduced to 40

===Scavengers===
* [[KRISS Vector]] damage reduced to 30, range reduced to 40

===Bug Fixes===
* Fixed bugs that led to anomalies from previous match appearing on next location 
* Fixed bug with buying upgrades for the gold/silver
* Fixed errors in the operation of Achievements system
* Fixed various visual bugs on the "London" map
* Fixed several bugs in the interface
* Fixed some errors in localization
* Fixed several critical errors that led to the game client crash
